cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this last installment of the Reasoning Deep Dive mini-series for AI and C Sharp and the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，這是 C# AI 與 Microsoft Agent Framework 深入推理功能系列的最後一部分。

cues.en: We have already looked at an intro, OpenAI and Google and how they do it.
cues.zh: 前面已經看過概念、OpenAI 與 Google 的做法。

cues.en: Now we're going to look into Entropic and their Claude models on how they do it.
cues.zh: 現在要介紹 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型。

cues.en: So let's jump into Visual Studio and go to the ReasoningEffort.Entropic sample.
cues.zh: 進入 Visual Studio，開啟 ReasoningEffort.Anthropic 範例。

cues.en: So Entropic, all modern models can do thinking, there's nothing special, they don't have reasoning
cues.zh: Anthropic 所有現代模型都能思考，沒有另外區分推理型，

cues.en: models and non-reasoning models, all of them can do it.
cues.zh: 與非推理型，每個模型都能啟用。

cues.en: And in this one, I'm going to write a little more advanced question.
cues.zh: 這次我會問一個稍微進階的問題。

cues.en: And the main reason for that is to show you how even the simpler questions here, it's
cues.zh: 主要是為了示範，即使只是這種稍微，

cues.en: a little more complex, can go wrong when it comes to not having any thinking.
cues.zh: 複雜一點的問題，未啟用思考時也可能出錯。

cues.en: Because out-of-the-box Entropic don't have any thinking with this baseline.
cues.zh: 因為 Anthropic 這個基準範例，預設不會思考。

cues.en: So if I do this, and you can see the question is now, what is the capital of the country
cues.zh: 問題是：「艾菲爾鐵塔所在國家的首都是哪裡，

cues.en: where the Eiffel Tower sits, and how is it to live there, and how many people live there?
cues.zh: 住在那裡感覺如何，以及有多少人口？」

cues.en: Answer back in max three words.
cues.zh: 最多用三個詞回答。

cues.en: So if we look at the baseline, we are again using these chat options, but that is not
cues.zh: 看看基準設定，我們一樣使用 ChatOptions，但，

cues.en: because we're setting anything default here, but because we always need to set this max output tokens on Claude models, which is really annoying.
cues.zh: 不是為了調整推理，而是 Claude 一定得指定 MaxOutputTokens，這點真的有點煩。

cues.en: But again, I will later show Agent Framework Toolkit, that makes it easier.
cues.zh: 稍後一樣會示範用 Agent Framework Toolkit 簡化。

cues.en: But we need to set it, and for that reason, we set this up, but else we just run it and not set anything thinking.
cues.zh: 總之先設定必要的輸出上限，其他直接使用預設，不指定 Thinking。

cues.en: And if we do that and let it run, we'll see it's, now it runs, and you can see it's very
cues.zh: 執行後，可以看到它回覆，

cues.en: fast to answer back, zero reasoning.
cues.zh: 非常快，推理用量是零。

cues.en: And that is because Entropic can't report reasoning back, so this will be zero all the way through, no matter what we're reasoning, because they simply don't report it back in
cues.zh: 不過 Anthropic 不會單獨回報推理 Token，所以這個欄位不論是否有思考，都會是零，因為 API，

cues.en: their LLM calls.
cues.zh: 沒有提供這個數字。

cues.en: And we might see, oh, that's good, out of the box, there's no reasoning, I can choose whenever I want to have it more advanced.
cues.zh: 你可能覺得這很好，預設不思考，需要時再開啟。

cues.en: But you already need to have it more advanced, because look at the answer back.
cues.zh: 但看看回覆，其實已經需要開啟了。

cues.en: It says Paris, France, expensive, vibrant, 2.2 million.
cues.zh: 它回答：Paris、France、Expensive、Vibrant、220 萬。

cues.en: It's not the 2.2, the other said 2.1, but it's not following the rules.
cues.zh: 問題不在於 220 萬與別人的 210 萬不同，而是沒有遵守格式。

cues.en: And Entropic is not too good at following rules in general, but it actually uses more than three words.
cues.zh: Anthropic 這個模型不太擅長遵守指示，實際用了超過三個詞。

cues.en: So you can see there's five words here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以數到五個。

cues.en: So even with no thinking and a little more hard question, had I not put in the extra
cues.zh: 所以即使只是稍微增加難度，不思考也可能出錯；如果沒有加上，

cues.en: thing, how it is to live there and so on, this would still have used the three words.
cues.zh: 居住感受這個額外問題，也許就能只用三個詞。

cues.en: But this is where reasoning comes in, because if we run this again, and this works a little
cues.zh: 這時推理就能幫上忙。再執行一次，設定方式有點，

cues.en: like the Gemini 2.5, where we set max allowed tokens, in this case, it's called budget tokens.
cues.zh: 像 Gemini 2.5，以 Token 額度控制，這裡稱為 BudgetTokens。

cues.en: So if we do that, we, next to the max tokens, also set our thinking, where we need to set
cues.zh: 除了 MaxTokens，也要設定 Thinking，並建立，

cues.en: some message creation parameters, set the max tokens, set the model again, so we need to set the model twice now.
cues.zh: MessageCreateParams，再指定 MaxTokens 與 Model，所以模型現在要指定兩次。

cues.en: And then we have something called thinking config param, where we need to say it's enabled
cues.zh: 接著有 ThinkingConfigParam，表示啟用，

cues.en: and how many tokens we allow, and the minimum is 1,024.
cues.zh: 以及允許使用多少 Token，最低是 1,024。

cues.en: But if we do this, and let's set a breakpoint up here after it has called this, it will
cues.zh: 這裡在呼叫之後設個中斷點，就會發現，

cues.en: begin to take time.
cues.zh: 開始需要比較多時間。

cues.en: But now it can actually understand that it needs to do it in three words.
cues.zh: 不過現在就能理解必須用三個詞回答。

cues.en: So without reasoning, at least this very cheap model of Claude is too unintelligent to even
cues.zh: 所以至少這個很便宜的小型 Claude，不啟用推理時甚至，

cues.en: follow the rules of answer back in max three words.
cues.zh: 無法遵守最多三個詞的要求。

cues.en: But if we give it budget meaning, throw more money at it, it is possible for it to use the three words.
cues.zh: 增加預算，也就是多花費用後，才有辦法控制在三個詞。

cues.en: And the reasoning also shows that, down here it says, but they want it back in three words max, but let's think about prioritize.
cues.zh: 推理摘要也顯示，它想到使用者要求最多三個詞，因此需要決定優先回答什麼。

cues.en: So it already thought about it could answer in a more elaborate way, but oh yeah, it checks
cues.zh: 原本它想提供更多內容，但又檢查，

cues.en: that's three words, that's three words, that's three words, which one of them should I use and go on and talk back and forth in order to figure it out.
cues.zh: 這個是三個詞、那個也是三個詞，該選哪種，反覆思考。

cues.en: And we see that it's reported back as just output tokens, again, it's a zero reasoning,
cues.zh: 用量仍然全部列為輸出 Token，推理欄位是零，

cues.en: but some of these were reasoning, they just don't tell how much is reasoning, how much is not, which is annoying.
cues.zh: 但其中一部分其實是推理，只是沒有分別提供數字，這有點不方便。

cues.en: But that's just the way they do things.
cues.zh: 不過他們就是這樣實作。

cues.en: So we can do this, and as we can see, even with such a simple question, reasoning is
cues.zh: 可以看到，連這種簡單問題，Anthropic 都，

cues.en: actually kind of needed in Anthropic, meaning it's kind of annoying that they default go to zero.
cues.zh: 可能需要推理，所以預設完全停用反而麻煩。

cues.en: Because before we thought, yeah, that's nice, but if they can't even follow rules like this, we need to begin to put all this in all the time.
cues.zh: 原本覺得這樣很好，但如果連這些要求都無法遵守，就得每次加入這些設定。

cues.en: And for that reason, again, Agent Framework Toolkit, my NuGet packages on that, make it
cues.zh: 因此我的 Agent Framework Toolkit，

cues.en: very simple, and we make an Anthropic agent, we make the agent, and we just set the budget tokens here directly.
cues.zh: 會讓設定變簡單：建立 AnthropicAgentFactory，再直接指定 BudgetTokens。

cues.en: And again, we can get our reasoning content back with the extension method.
cues.zh: 同樣能透過擴充方法取得推理內容。

cues.en: So once it's thought about it, it should hopefully do the exact same.
cues.zh: 思考後，希望能完成相同要求。

cues.en: Now we're going from beautiful to expensive, but fair enough, and it forgot.
cues.zh: 這次把漂亮改成昂貴，但少了一項內容。

cues.en: So even 2,000 tokens is not enough to remember to actually get back that it also needed to answer the 2.2.
cues.zh: 所以即使用兩千個 Token 思考，仍然忘了也要回答 220 萬人口。

cues.en: Again, the life of Anthropic, they're intelligent, they're good at coding, but following rules,
cues.zh: 這就是我使用 Anthropic 的感受：聰明，也擅長程式開發，但遵守指示，

cues.en: that's not their strong suit.
cues.zh: 不是這個小模型的強項。

cues.en: And yes, it comes back still as output tokens instead of reasoning tokens.
cues.zh: 同樣地，用量仍顯示為輸出 Token，而不是推理 Token。

cues.en: So Anthropic is not my preferred choice, to be honest.
cues.zh: 老實說，這讓 Anthropic 不是我優先選擇的供應商。

cues.en: And I really like my models to be able to follow rules, and they certainly are not good at it.
cues.zh: 我希望模型能遵守要求，但這個範例表現不理想。

cues.en: Only by throwing a lot of reasoning after it, they begin to become good at it again, which is annoying.
cues.zh: 必須投入大量推理才開始改善，這讓人有點困擾。

cues.en: And again, annoying to set all this up.
cues.zh: 而且設定起來也麻煩。

cues.en: Even if we use the Agent Framework Toolkit, we need to put in extra lines just to make it something that can actually talk.
cues.zh: 即使用 Toolkit，還是要多加幾行設定，才能比較妥善地回答。

cues.en: And now, of course, I'm choosing the very small model.
cues.zh: 當然，這裡刻意使用的是非常小的模型。

cues.en: The Opus and Sonnet models are much more capable.
cues.zh: Opus 與 Sonnet 的能力強得多。

cues.en: So of course, you can make an Anthropic agent tell the truth and follow rules, but it just
cues.zh: 所以當然能讓 Anthropic 正確回答並遵守指示，只是，

cues.en: takes more effort and more money and more time.
cues.zh: 需要更多設定、費用與時間。

cues.en: So that is all the three models.
cues.zh: 以上就是三個供應商的模型。

cues.en: If we talk a little about more of the other models, there's things like Grok.
cues.zh: 另外簡單談其他模型，例如 Grok。

cues.en: Grok uses OpenAI, but if you try to set the various reasoning efforts on them, it just throws an exception.
cues.zh: Grok 使用 OpenAI 相容介面，但如果設定不同推理強度，就會拋出例外。

cues.en: They talk a little about having internal things for setting reasoning, but it seems to not
cues.zh: 他們提到有內部的推理控制方式，但看起來還無法，

cues.en: be possible to make it work together with the Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 與 Agent Framework 正常整合。

cues.en: In the same manner, if you take some things like DeepSeek via OpenRouter or one of the
cues.zh: 同樣地，透過 OpenRouter 或其他平台使用 DeepSeek，

cues.en: others that exposes DeepSeek, you can again set these reasoning efforts, but it seems
cues.zh: 雖然可以指定推理強度，但似乎，

cues.en: to just ignore it and use its level of reasoning by itself.
cues.zh: 只是忽略設定，使用模型自己的推理程度。

cues.en: So it doesn't really seem you can do much more than the baseline on, if you at least want to use the Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 因此至少在 Agent Framework 裡，目前似乎只能採用預設行為。

cues.en: So in summary of these four videos, reasoning is important.
cues.zh: 這四支影片的重點是，推理非常重要。

cues.en: Too many people don't know why it's important.
cues.zh: 很多人還不知道它為什麼重要。

cues.en: I don't want to make my users sit and wait for the answer back.
cues.zh: 我不想讓使用者一直等待答案，

cues.en: I don't want to spend more tokens than needed.
cues.zh: 也不想使用超出必要的 Token。

cues.en: So I really, really want to control it, especially because I'm using default OpenAI, and I really
cues.zh: 因此很希望能控制推理，尤其平常主要使用 OpenAI，

cues.en: need to steer that with the minimal and low efforts for most of the things, only bumping
cues.zh: 大部分工作都需要調成 Minimal 或 Low，只有，

cues.en: it up when I know it's really, really important.
cues.zh: 確定有必要時才提高。

cues.en: While if switching to Google, it sounds like I could have a much easier time by its new
cues.zh: 如果改成 Google，新的自動推理，

cues.en: auto-reasoning capabilities, which is really, really cool from a technical perspective.
cues.zh: 可能讓控制容易很多，技術上相當不錯。

cues.en: Google seems to be ahead, and then comes OpenAI because it can follow the rules, and then
cues.zh: 我認為 Google 目前領先，其次是能遵守要求的 OpenAI，再來，

cues.en: Anthropic, in my mind, is behind on this in quality of reasoning.
cues.zh: 才是這個範例中推理表現較弱的 Anthropic。

cues.en: But that's everything from this miniseries.
cues.zh: 這個小系列就到這裡。

cues.en: If you want to see more or have any questions, feel free to put them in the comments. See you around.
cues.zh: 如果想看更多或有任何問題，歡迎留言，我們下次見。
